problem_statement.description: Given a collection of intervals where each interval contains a start and end value, merge all intervals that overlap. Return a collection of non-overlapping intervals that covers the same ranges as the original input. Intervals that only touch at a boundary are considered overlapping when their ranges intersect.
problem_statement.input: A collection of intervals represented by start and end values.
problem_statement.output: A collection of merged, non-overlapping intervals.
important_conditions: Touching intervals are considered overlapping when their ranges intersect.

expected_algorithm.approach: Sort the intervals by starting value and then merge overlapping intervals while traversing the sorted intervals.
steps: Add the first interval to the result when applicable.
Compare each interval with the last merged interval.
If they overlap, extend the last interval's end.
Otherwise add the current interval separately.

expected_reasoning_steps: Compare each interval with the last merged interval.
edge_cases: Intervals with the same starting value
common_mistakes: Failing to extend the end to the maximum
